# ➈ Lilly Pulitzer Virtual Runway

[Art Direction](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/lilly#)

Shop the look straight off the virtual runway. My crew took on some after-work-hours to imagine how Lilly Pulitzer could show up in a totally virtual world. After launching the Lilly mobile app, we used some of that momentum to illustrate what a virtual activation could look like for the brand. I worked with 3 creative directors to shape our pitch and led 4 designers, and a production team to make it feel real.
